meta.title: Let's Meet at the Square
meta.textType: dialogue: where and when to meet

paragraphs: At break on Thursday, Tom and Ben sat on the grass next to the field. Hugo, a boy in Tom's class, sat next to them. Ben had a new green bike, and Hugo had an old blue bike. "Are you interested in a bike ride on Saturday?" asked Tom. "Yes, I am," said Ben. "Where shall we meet?" "Hugo, do you want to come?" asked Tom. "Yes, please," said Hugo. "I love bike rides."

"Let's meet at the square," said Tom. "It is next to the library." "I agree," said Hugo. "My house is near the square." "Is it far from your house?" asked Ben. "No, it is five minutes from my house," said Hugo. "What time shall we meet?" asked Ben. "At nine o'clock," said Tom. "That is too early for me," said Ben. "I have football practice until a quarter past nine."

"Then we meet at half past nine," said Tom. "Do you both agree?" "I agree," said Ben. "Me too," said Hugo. "Where do we ride?" asked Hugo. "To the lake and back," said Tom. "Shall we take water and fruit?" asked Ben. "Yes, and a hat," said Tom. "It will be hot."

Tom took a small paper from his bag. "Let me write it down," he said. "Saturday, at the square, at half past nine," said Tom. Ben and Hugo both read the paper. "Good idea!" said Hugo. "I must be home at one o'clock," said Tom. Tom smiled, and he was very happy about the ride. The break ended, and the three boys went back to class.
text.summary: Tom, Ben, and Hugo plan a bike ride. They talk about the place, the day, and the time, and then they write the plan on a paper.
